name: bhakt_bgm
caption: Instrumental Indian devotional background score for a village devotional story video, warm gentle hopeful mood, evening at a river ghat near an old Ram temple. Soft bansuri flute melody, harmonium, sitar, tanpura drone, light tabla and manjira, a few temple bells. Tender, peaceful, devotional, uplifting, no sadness, no vocals, no singing, no chant, steady gentle rhythm.
